Method of Attack: File-encrypting ransomware demanding ransom payments in Bitcoin
Combines 2048-bit RSA keys with 256-bit AES encryption
Threaded encryption process for quicker operation
Shares significant code with BitPaymer but uses different encryption schemes
Impacted Systems: City of Edcouch, Texas computer systems
Chilean Ministry of Agriculture public service servers
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection targeting public service sector systems
Likely via compromised servers or endpoints
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes demanding between 2 BTC and 100 BTC
Ransom note demanding 8 BTC from City of Edcouch
Confirmation of ransomware attack by Chilean Ministry of Agriculture CSIRT on July 1, 2019
